title: Understanding the Effectiveness of Peer Educator Outreach on Reducing Sexually Transmitted Infections: The Role of Prevention vs. Early Detection
authors: Sam K. Hui; Parthasarathy Krishnamurthy; Shiv Kumar; Hareesha B. Siddegowda; Prachi Patel
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Bayesian structural model (MCMC, C++) of weekly peer-educator visits, clinic visits and STI diagnoses for sex workers; PE visits recur week to week (not an absorbing adoption) and no TWFE regression is estimated.
design_notes: data and code/PE.cpp: MCMC (200,000 iterations) with Metropolis steps for theta, kappa, gamma/rho, delta; inputs are sex-worker x week 0/1 matrices (PEvisits.txt, clinic.txt, diagnosis.txt), nweeks.txt and demo.txt (2,705 sex workers).
data_files_note: Sex-worker x week data shipped as tab-delimited matrices.
data_provenance_note: README describes the files as the analysis data; no transformation stated.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
